# Northeastern Global News

> > Northeastern Global News is the university's official news platform covering research breakthroughs, campus life, faculty expertise, and analysis of global issues.

Northeastern Global News serves as the primary news and communications hub for Northeastern University, featuring university research, student and faculty spotlights, campus events, and expert analysis on contemporary global topics. The site provides resources for multiple audiences including students, faculty, families, and media professionals.

## Key Topics

- Northeastern University
- University Research
- Faculty Experts
- Campus Life
- Student Resources
- Media Relations
- Commencement
- AI and Technology
- Health Care Ethics
- Campus Safety
- Financial Aid
- Entertainment and Culture
- Research Innovation
- University News
- Faculty Spotlight

## Core News & Research

- [Northeastern Global News - News, Discovery, and Analysis from Around the World](https://news.northeastern.edu): Homepage for Northeastern Global News featuring university news, research, and analysis
- [NGN Research by Northeastern University](https://news.northeastern.edu/research): Showcase of groundbreaking research from Northeastern University faculty
- [Faculty Experts Archive - Northeastern Global News](https://news.northeastern.edu/faculty-experts): Directory of Northeastern faculty experts with research expertise profiles
- [In the Press Archive - Northeastern Global News](https://news.northeastern.edu/in-the-media): Archive of Northeastern faculty mentions and research coverage in media

## Campus Community Resources

- [Information for Northeastern Parents and Families - Northeastern Global News](https://news.northeastern.edu/parents): Resource hub for Northeastern parents and families with campus guides
- [Faculty & Staff News Hub - Northeastern Global News](https://news.northeastern.edu/faculty-staff): News and resources for Northeastern faculty and staff members

## Featured Analysis & Stories

- [What is the Strait of Hormuz, and Why Does it Matter?](https://news.northeastern.edu/2026/03/19/what-is-the-straight-of-hormuz): Analysis of Strait of Hormuz geopolitics and global energy security
- [Intrinsic Motivation at Work May Cost You, Research Reveals](https://news.northeastern.edu/2026/03/18/intrinsic-motivation-at-work-burnout-research): Northeastern research on workplace motivation and employee burnout
- [Why the Bacterial Meningitis Outbreak in the UK is so Dangerous](https://news.northeastern.edu/2026/03/20/meningitis-outbreak-uk): Expert analysis of UK bacterial meningitis outbreak and public health risks
- [What 'Project Hail Mary' Gets Right and Wrong About Astrophysics](https://news.northeastern.edu/2026/03/19/project-hail-mary-accuracy-astrophysics): Astrophysicist fact-checks Project Hail Mary film science accuracy
- [Already Building AI? "Agentic AI Book" Fills Knowledge Gaps](https://news.northeastern.edu/2026/03/13/agentic-ai-book-ryan): Review of Agentic AI Book addressing AI development knowledge gaps
